gaps.title: Task creation collects only a title — every other property is post-creation
gaps.ask: Task banate waqt hi name, description, assign, start/due date + time, priority, tags, time estimate, dependency, subtasks aur checklist sab ek hi dialog mein set ho jayen
gaps.why: quick-create-modal.tsx TaskForm posts { listId, title, priority:'normal' } and nothing else; the list quick-add adds only a priority select and one date input. Users must create a stub, find it, open the detail sheet and fill nine fields — ClickUp does it in one modal with a chip row (TO DO / Assignee / Due date / Priority / Tags / …) plus a 'Fields' section and a 'Create Task ⌄' split button.

gaps.title: Start and due dates cannot carry a time of day
gaps.ask: Start date daali to time bhi poochhe (7 PM), due date daali to us ka bhi time (9:15) — 'proper duration' bane
gaps.why: The DB already stores timestamptz (packages/db/src/schema/tasks.ts:30-31) and the API parses full datetimes (tasks.controller.ts:149-153), but the only inputs are <input type="date"> at task-detail-sheet.tsx:1553-1568. Time is unrepresentable in the UI, so 'due today at 7pm' collapses to 'due today' and every downstream reminder, calendar and workload view is coarse.

gaps.title: No way to put a tag on a task anywhere in the product
gaps.ask: Tags create kar saken — task ke ooper feature ke lehaz se tag rakh sakein, likh ke Enter dabao to naya tag ban jaye (YouTube jaisa)
gaps.why: The whole backend is there (labels + task_label_assignments, POST/DELETE /tasks/:taskId/labels/:labelId at tasks.controller.ts:314-329) and the detail sheet renders label badges at :865-874, but no component ever calls those endpoints — grep for '/labels/' in apps/web/src hits only the settings rename/delete. Bulk actions don't offer labels either. Tags are effectively write-only via Workspace Settings and can never reach a task.

gaps.title: Task description has no slash-command editor (no table, banner, image or embed)
gaps.ask: Description mein slash click karke table bana loon, banners rakhoon, image embed karoon — bilkul document ki tarah design kar sakoon
gaps.why: Docs already have this (docs-panel.tsx:364, :494-504 — h2/todo/bullet/quote/code/table/divider/callout/listEmbed) but the task description is a plain markdown textarea with an 8-button toolbar (task-detail-sheet.tsx:1415-1456). ClickUp's task description is the same editor as its docs, with TEXT / INLINE (mention person, page, task, whiteboard) / VIEWS (list as table, list, board) / EMBEDS (website, GIPHY, CloudApp, Google Drive) sections.

gaps.title: Create modal is missing Reminder, Whiteboard and Dashboard tabs
gaps.ask: Task banane ke baad woh Document ka poochta hai, phir Reminder ka, phir Whiteboard ka, phir Dashboard ka — sab ek hi jagah se
gaps.why: quick-create-modal.tsx:19-26 offers Task | List | Folder | Project | Space | Doc. Whiteboards, Dashboards and Reminders all exist as features (routes app.$workspaceId.whiteboards.tsx / app.$workspaceId.dashboard.tsx, schema reminders.ts) but are unreachable from the one place a user goes to create something.

gaps.title: Cannot create a List from inside the task-create flow, and cannot mark it private at creation
gaps.ask: Space select karo to woh khud bole 'pehle list banao' — list na banao to task create hi na ho; wahin se list bane aur poochhe ke PRIVATE karni hai ke nahi
gaps.why: Rundesk gates task creation on an existing List but offers no escape hatch: the user has to close the modal, switch to the List tab (which itself needs an existing Project), create, then reopen. And POST /lists (lists.controller.ts:37-44) accepts only { projectId, name, description } — visibility is create-time-unsettable even though the column and the PUT path both support it, so a private list is public for however long it takes to find the sidebar context menu.

gaps.title: No 'List settings' step after a list is created
gaps.ask: List banne ke baad poochhe ke view kaisa chahiye — main abhi 'no thanks' karoon aur baad mein set kar loon
gaps.why: Both create paths navigate straight into the empty list. ClickUp's step offers four independently checkable cards — Default Task Type, Default views (List, Board), Custom Fields (AI-generated), Statuses (Not Started → In Progress → Completed) — with 'No thanks' / 'Apply suggestions'. Every one of those settings already exists in Rundesk (space-views-dialog.tsx, list-statuses-manager.tsx, custom-fields schema, task_types.isDefault); nothing surfaces them at the one moment the user is thinking about the list's shape, so new lists ship with defaults nobody chose.

gaps.title: Task type cannot be chosen while creating a task
gaps.ask: Task banate waqt hi upar 'Task ⌄' se decide ho ke yeh Task hai ya Milestone
gaps.why: Task types are fully built (task_types table, workspace settings CRUD, PATCH /tasks/:id/task-type) but the picker at task-detail-sheet.tsx:398-435 only appears after the task exists, so every task is born untyped/default and someone has to go back and reclassify.

gaps.title: Date picker has no natural-language presets and no recurrence entry point
gaps.ask: Date choose karte waqt Today / Tomorrow / This weekend / Next week / 2 weeks / 4 weeks aur 'Set Recurring' wahin milein
gaps.why: Rundesk uses a bare native <input type="date">; grep shows no such presets outside inbox snooze (catalogs.ts:4653). Recurrence exists but is a separate 'Repeat' select further down the detail sheet (:1570-1601). Setting 'due next week' is four clicks and a mental date calculation instead of one.

gaps.title: A List cannot live directly under a Space — a Project is always required
gaps.ask: Pehle space hoti hai, is ke baad space ke andar LISTS hoti hain
gaps.why: packages/db/src/schema/lists.ts:10 makes projectId notNull, and every create path (quick-create-modal.tsx:245 disables the Project select until a Space is picked and blocks submit without projectId; workspace-project-shell-page.tsx creates only within a project) enforces it. The client's model — and ClickUp's — is Space → List, with Folder optional. The extra mandatory level shows up in the task-create picker as a third dropdown and in every breadcrumb.

gaps.title: 'My Tasks' is buried inside Home instead of being a sidebar group with its own routes
gaps.ask: My Tasks sidebar mein ho, us ke neeche Assigned to me / Today & Overdue / Personal List — aur profile pe click karo to bhi wahin se pahunch sakein
gaps.why: All three sections exist (app.$workspaceId.tsx:262-266) but only as buttons inside the Home page's left card: no /my-tasks URL, nothing shareable or bookmarkable, no entry in workspace-sidebar.tsx (its label list at :468-490 has no 'My Tasks'), and the topbar avatar menu (catalogs.ts:55-63, :4914-4922) has no 'My Work' or 'Create task' quick actions the way ClickUp's Personal Tools block does.

gaps.title: Create dialog footer has no template picker, attachment or notify control
gaps.ask: Task create karte waqt neeche Templates, attach aur notification (bell) ke controls hon
gaps.why: quick-create-modal.tsx:411-438 offers only 'Start from a template' and 'Import' links that navigate away and lose the half-filled form. Task templates already carry priority, estimate, date offsets, labels, checklists, subtasks and custom-field values (task-templates-section.tsx:41-50) but can only be applied from the Templates page; attachments and watchers are detail-sheet-only.

gaps.title: Dead start-date state in the list quick-add
gaps.why: apps/web/src/routes/app.$workspaceId.$spaceId.$projectId.$listId.tsx:980 declares newTaskStartDate and :1172 sends it in the create body, but no input is ever bound to setNewTaskStartDate — the value is permanently ''. Either wire an input or drop the field; as written it reads like a start date is settable at quick-add when it never is.
